method: All 24 exported ranges were actually viewed as six 1:1 native-pixel boards using view_image(detail=original); suspected notches were viewed again as 1:1 local crops. No resampling, image edits or pixel metrics were used to declare acceptance.

summary.status: corrected after focused native review: local existing contour and tone refinement required; original candidate not accepted
summary.limitations: This report covers only the requested 24 horizontal/guide ranges and visible secondary artifacts. It does not approve full tile, outer boundaries, all vertical seams, navigation or client display.

findings.observation: 原像素实看，已有斜槽的米白亮边及棕色暗槽在参考带结束附近出现小台阶/折口，两个局部位于 x约245 与650；不是物件缺失，也不是需要新增墙或槽线。
findings.recommendation: 只修正已有亮边与暗槽的局部几何接续，保留槽线走向、宽度和地图占地；不能靠羽化模糊掩盖。

findings.observation: 原像素局部板可见斜槽亮边在 x3187、y约3008 处的小折口；该点属于竖向参考边带交界，位于 y3072 标准横缝上方。作为裁图内次要发现记录，不能据此判 y3072 横缝错位。
findings.recommendation: 与竖缝/竖向参考带审查结果去重，局部修已有斜槽亮边及暗边的连续性。

findings.observation: 追加局部实看发现栏板暗斜边原图接续回跳；对原首轮未发现问题的判断作更正。
